title: The Marmalade Prophecy
skyStory: The moon strolls into Taurus, eighty-seven percent full and slow as honey. Venus, ruler of Taurus, has set up a picnic blanket in the field of stars and is arranging tiny jars in neat rows. The bull in the constellation lies down for a nap. Saturn approves of the blanket. Mars wants to know why everyone is moving so slowly. Nobody answers. They are too comfortable.

reading: Taurus slows the whole world down to a comfortable stroll, and the Tiger is going to have to match it. Today, a strangely specific word will show up in a conversation when nobody should be saying it: marmalade. A stranger will say it, or a sign, or a show playing in the background. You will blink.

Then Nancy will mention marmalade too, completely unprompted, sometime before 8 pm. Don't even scream. The universe does not explain these things; it simply leaves them on the counter like a jar with a ribbon. The [[Nine of Cups]] in your spread warns of hollow wishes, but this one is full, ridiculous, and sticky with delight.
joel.mission: Use the word marmalade naturally in a conversation today without anyone realizing it was a mission.
joel.omen: Something orange and glowing in a jar or a window. A small coincidence is on its way.

reading: The Taurus moon makes everything cozy and unhurried, and you are going to savour it. A long breakfast. A lingering coffee. A conversation that wanders off topic into somewhere delightful. During one of those wanders, the word marmalade will tumble out of your mouth for no reason at all.

When Joel tells you he heard it too, the Wood Rat will sit up straight. ΔΕΣ, obviously. Spend the rest of the day enjoying small pleasures without guilt: soft socks, a good book, the smell of a woodstove somewhere down the street. The [[Four of Pentacles]] reversed says relax your grip and enjoy what you have.
nancy.mission: Spend one hour today doing something purely because it feels nice, and do not explain it to anybody.
nancy.omen: An unexpected word repeated twice in one day. The universe is reading your diary over your shoulder.

together.text: After the marmalade moment, invent a jam flavour that could only exist in your shared universe, such as Fire Tiger Pepper or Mountain Mist. Write its label. DES is now a recognized category of jam in the Taurus pantry, top shelf.

game.intro: Don't even scream, the marmalade predicted this exact question. Guess under, and keep the toast away from the tiles.
game.question: Add up every pip on all 28 tiles of a standard double-six domino set. What is the total?
